title: Herod hears about Jesus
description: Tetrarch Herod is perplexed when he hears about all that is happening around Jesus. Some say that John has risen from the dead, others that Elijah has appeared, and still others that one of the old prophets has been raised up. Herod remembers that he himself beheaded John and wonders who this man is about whom he hears such things. He therefore seeks to see Jesus.
